LanguageData.LP_LegendaryResistance.label: legendary resistance
LanguageData.LP_LegendaryResistance.description: Legendary creatures can shrug off one control effect that should have taken hold: stuns, externally caused mental states, control-type conditions and pain downing; each use consumes one, and the effect fails completely. Fully restored each game day; one extra in their own lair. Legendary adventurers gain 1 per 5 levels.
LanguageData.LP_LegendaryActions.label: legendary points
LanguageData.LP_LegendaryActions.description: Legendary creatures can act in the gaps between others' moves: each time an enemy within 15 cells finishes an attack, it spends a legendary point on a legendary action. Recovers 1 point every 4 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_Frightened.label: frightened
LanguageData.LP_Frightened.description: Frightened by the frightful presence of a legendary creature: weak in the limbs, can't aim well or run fast.
LanguageData.LP_LairSandstorm.label: lair sandstorm
LanguageData.LP_LairSandstorm.description: Sand whipped up in the dragon lair gets in the eyes: ranged hit chance reduced.
LanguageData.LP_LairDarkness.label: lair darkness
LanguageData.LP_LairDarkness.description: Magical darkness called by a black dragon: can't see a thing, hit chance sharply reduced.
